moments.author: Garrett Langley
moments.quote: If we want to live in a society where, if you commit a crime, you have a higher probability of being held accountable, we shouldn’t pause progress.
moments.why: His defense of controversial surveillance tech sparked a firestorm around privacy vs safety.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Starlink is licensed in over 165 countries ... so why still no license? Is Ambani the real boss of India?
moments.why: Musk’s pointed jab at Indian regulatory delays went viral amid telecom power struggles.

moments.author: Flock CEO (TechCrunch)
moments.quote: Flock to offer defaults but minimize mandated misuse protections; layoffs intensify backlash.
moments.why: The company’s strategy amid privacy protests is trending heavily among tech and civic groups.
